title: Make the one-command Windows ReMCP installation resilient to non-admin permissions and multilingual user profiles.
changes: Keep irm https://remcp.site/i | iex as the sole Windows onboarding command. Retry an interrupted, already-approved pairing without rotating its device credentials.

Create an interactive least-privilege Windows Task Scheduler entry when permitted. When task registration is denied, verify nonexistence using locale-independent COM status and use per-user Startup without elevation.

Route localized, Unicode or shell-sensitive Windows account paths through Windows Script Host and a managed Node supervisor instead of codepage-dependent CMD scripts; preserve safe ASCII profiles with ordinary Task Scheduler.
Authenticate local control commands and responses, prevent duplicate agents, stop or restart only owned child processes and clean stale per-user Startup registrations safely.
Keep denied writes to the user PATH nonfatal, report policy restrictions honestly and never bypass enterprise application-control policies.
Validate the Windows lifecycle on native hosted Windows with CMD, WScript, Unicode and six UI language cultures, plus ASUS regressions and release checks.
